searchText: the issue appeared on the nimbus full node side, the response checker was iterating 1 by 1, instead of the hopping through the custody columns, which is why the inconsistent messgae, but it has been fixed from our side as well only for range Hi guys, any thoughts and comments on this [PeerDAS metrics list](https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-metrics/pull/14) - verification, reconstruction, computation? I guess, `beacon_kzg_verification_data_column_single_seconds` and `beacon_kzg_verification_data_column_batch_seconds` could be confusing. Here is <@654267572107083777> comment on it (copied from PR): `typically, single/batched verifications are an adaptive set of tactics used by the clients which depends on anticipated prevalence of failures which require rerunning verifications individually, for example, not per se something that's baked into how a protocol is set up. While the notional stated purpose of these is precisely to achieve a unified UX of sorts across CLs, even the happy paths here involve different batching sizes, which again depends on specific tradeoffs of latency/throughput/tolerance to single verification fallback/many other considerations. These might be difficult to interpret within one client over time, as well as across clients.` Should we add them for monitoring to be sure kzg verification runs normally? Do all the clients use both single and batch? > beacon_kzg_verification_data_column_single_seconds and beacon_kzg_verification_data_column_batch_seconds we use this https://github.com/ethereum/c-kzg-4844/blob/main/bindings/nim/kzg.nim#L289-L313 and this is `verifyCellKzgProofBatch`, I don't think non batched cell kzg proof verification is exposed publicly, please correct me if i am wrong <@592004585506340885> so i'm not sure how and where `beacon_kzg_verification_data_column_single_seconds` would fit in `nimbus-eth2` https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-metrics/pull/14 here additionally, is `beacon_data_column_sidecar_processing_requests_total` anyhow congruent to persisted into the database successfully? cc <@564345498471759890> or like saved post verification? also, by `beacon_data_column_sidecar_computation_seconds` you mean when i compute data columns at the time of block proposal from blobs? The idea is to exclude any losses during the data column gossip verification process, so `processing_requests` before the verification should be equal to `processing_successes` after the verification (can comment/clarify here on my GitHub comments if useful) Correct. There is only batched cell verification. But you could give it a single column I suppose. yep What do you all think about renaming EIP-7594 to Fulu? https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3994 To get the Fulu ball rolling. I’d personally hold off tbh as I don’t think we have 100% committed for peerdas in fulu. Hmm it feels like a sure thing to me. But maybe I'm too optimistic. I spent 6 months to stop confusing 7594 with 7954. Not sir.

excerpts.author: agnxsh
excerpts.content: the issue appeared on the nimbus full node side, the response checker was iterating 1 by 1, instead of the hopping through the custody columns, which is why the inconsistent messgae, but it has been fixed from our side as well

excerpts.author: sibkatya
excerpts.content:
Hi guys, any thoughts and comments on this [PeerDAS metrics list](https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-metrics/pull/14) - verification, reconstruction, computation? 

I guess, `beacon_kzg_verification_data_column_single_seconds` and `beacon_kzg_verification_data_column_batch_seconds` could be confusing. 

Here is <@654267572107083777> comment on it (copied from PR):
`typically, single/batched verifications are an adaptive set of tactics used by the clients which depends on anticipated prevalence of failures which require rerunning verifications individually, for example, not per se something that's baked into how a protocol is set up. While the notional stated purpose of these is precisely to achieve a unified UX of sorts across CLs, even the happy paths here involve different batching sizes, which again depends on specific tradeoffs of latency/throughput/tolerance to single verification fallback/many other considerations. These might be difficult to interpret within one client over time, as well as across clients.`

Should we add them for monitoring to be sure kzg verification runs normally? Do all the clients use both single and batch?

excerpts.author: agnxsh
excerpts.content:
> beacon_kzg_verification_data_column_single_seconds and beacon_kzg_verification_data_column_batch_seconds
we use this https://github.com/ethereum/c-kzg-4844/blob/main/bindings/nim/kzg.nim#L289-L313 and this is `verifyCellKzgProofBatch`, I don't think non batched cell kzg proof verification is exposed publicly, please correct me if i am wrong <@592004585506340885>

excerpts.author: agnxsh
excerpts.content: so i'm not sure how and where `beacon_kzg_verification_data_column_single_seconds` would fit in `nimbus-eth2`

excerpts.content: https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-metrics/pull/14 here additionally, is `beacon_data_column_sidecar_processing_requests_total` anyhow congruent to persisted into the database successfully? cc <@564345498471759890>

excerpts.author: agnxsh
excerpts.content: also, by `beacon_data_column_sidecar_computation_seconds` you mean when i compute data columns at the time of block proposal from blobs?

excerpts.author: sibkatya
excerpts.content: The idea is to exclude any losses during the data column gossip verification process,  so `processing_requests` before the verification should be equal to `processing_successes` after the verification
